tagline: Advanced Tabular PDF Extraction, Hierarchical Folder Generator & Drive Inventory
newFeatures: High-Performance Tabular PDF to CSV Extraction with vector cell parsing and fuzzy synonym header mapping.
Hierarchical Directory Generator: transforms tabular data into nested production file trees automatically.
Media Boundary Scanner & Sorter: multi-cameraman media sorting, ripple sequence shifting, and isolated move.
Drive Inventory Engine: automated gap verification scan and formatted color-coded Excel report generator.
Dual Build Architecture: Standalone Portable executable and full GUI Setup installer with uninstaller.
improvements: Direct integration into the Anything Master Hub ecosystem.
PyWebView native Windows 11 hardware-accelerated frontend renderer.
Offline local SQLite database indexing with zero external network dependencies.
fixes: Smart text-wrap protection inside PDF table cells.
Vivo, Honor, and multi-display DPI scaling layout stability.
